For a_i<=t-2 a private vertex is a cone point. Otherwise the integral skeleton-chain boundary is contraction by augmentation, so top homology is wedge^{q+1}U_i. Join yields top dimensions r(t-1)-1 and r(t-2)-1 respectively; because dim L<conn K0, inclusion L->K0 is null. Cofibration K0 union (v*L) gives K0 vee suspension(L), with the lower degree r(t-2). Functorial join Kunneth and relative LES give the integral lattice actions, not an equivariant homotopy equivalence.
